question:
Figure A is related to B following a certain pattern. Following the same pattern, figure C is related to D. Study the pattern and select the figure which should be placed in place of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2eac16151543d700eb118bfdd4291c5d28bcc7a2c5b4d0d759b5189e9f0e44ae.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 
• Elements from left up corner to right below corner are shifting anti-clockwise diagonally.
 
• Elements from left below corner exchanged positions with right up corner element.

​So,

 
• Figures A and B ⇒ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7628978fdafcd4ca4317ebbc95ec4898b98602767ec6b61b96aad0973351bc50.png] ​

Similarly,

 
• Figure C and D ⇒ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73a5575e06300d9d58b6496f2b2e160ea56a4a80db1247ab64b34920d3d2051b.png] ​

Thus, final pattern is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/449aa010d73c51d969d987e4ab19c1d2e4400ed6cf78c6cd568990df23f8197f.png] 

Hence, "Option - (2)" is the correct answer.
